notes.title: (0.61) Real-Life Tetramon Plushies!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, the limited-time Tetramon plushies by Makeship are now available for preorder!

Preorder campaign will be open for 22 days to get your very own [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/pigni-plushie]Pigni[/url], [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/minstar-plushie]Minstar[/url], [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/nanomite-plushie]Nanomite[/url] and [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/nocti-plushie]Nocti[/url] plush! It's a joy to partner with Makeship to bring these Tetramon plushies from the game into the real world, I always wanted to display them on my shelf at home and now you can too :D

Check them out [url=https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/opneon-games]here![/url]

notes.title: Early access build 0.60 - Card Grading
notes.content:
Special thanks to the studio involved in this update:
[url=https://thunder-roar.com/]ThunderRoar Studio[/url]

Hi everyone, card grading is finally here, along with a few additional updates and bug fixes!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/898286cea96bf33600e3b1752f2e6d8e755c3b73.jpg[/img]
You can now send cards for grading via The Cardinal's Grading app on the phone. Select up to 8 cards to be graded in a package and wait for them to be sent back. The grading time and price will depend on the service type you choose.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/9e1edb0552eea49cd7208d3a2a763c3c92620af0.jpg[/img]
You can view your graded card in a special album. To access the album, sort it using "Graded" button. Graded card's pricing can be viewed in the price graph screen, select a specific grade to see its market price.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/42b393b3f458b06d9690d7a28fbc8cec5af34edc.jpg[/img]
Added Pack Opener Machines

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/40528476f8b935ebbe53829ba609612304070f5a.jpg[/img]
You can buy these machines at MY DIY. Feed card packs into the machine and it will open the card packs automatically for you. Different machine will have different capacity and pack opening time.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/0d5489fb230c677c04cf31d404c20a90c0043491.jpg[/img]
Added 2 new Play Tables (black/white)

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/7204727e1e068b63fded6b7ed75602887d5a267e.jpg[/img]
Added a new worker

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/f978606bbb6765ba372f06f5ad08000bd56afe14.jpg[/img]
Added chance to get god packs

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/863dc7539db2f369289dd878117dc893e78f1f38.jpg[/img]
Added 2 Wall Display Cases for cards

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/97adc0bdba105e0d51bd190cd63fc3e02a9999d7.jpg[/img]
[b]Additional Changelist:[/b]
-Increased credit card digit limit
-You can now throw cards into the trash bin
-Added 7 ceiling, 27 floor, and 28 wall materials
-Customers can now sell or trade their graded cards
-Customer trading now has a chance for them to request cards from your album instead of a random card
-Minor update to light switch material
-Closed boxes will now auto-open when dispensing items to shelves
-(Gamepad only) Added quick-select function to look at shelf items, price tags, and cards by using the D-pad. Applicable to item shelves, card tables, warehouse shelves, cashier counters, and card albums
Fix bug - sometimes unable to expand the shop when a poster is on the expanded wall
Fix bug - on controller, pressing the "Let Me Think" button will cause menu to be stuck
Fix bug - customer clothing LOD glitches

notes.title: Upcoming Update - Shop Decoration and Customization
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/262ec0efd9496b1bd35668bc5ed69ad113d473af.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone, the next update will be shop decoration, and I'm working hard alongside other 3D artists to get it finished. This feature is taking quite some time as there really are a lot of decoration assets to create, but rest assured, it will be coming very soon—most likely by the end of March or, at the latest, early April.

In this upcoming update, you'll be able to customize your shop with new floor, wall, and ceiling textures, as well as decorate your shop with items like posters and more. Can't wait to get this update done and see what kind of card shop you will be creating :)

tags.feature: In this upcoming update, you'll be able to customize your shop with new floor, wall, and ceiling textures, as well as decorate your shop with items like posters and more.
